title: The Clockwork Sasquatch
description: Justin's original cryptid: a wildman of brass and pine-needle, winding the forest's clocks.

title: The Lake-Singer
description: Justin's original cryptid: the singer of his world's deep lake, whose song lures only the curious.

title: The Ember-Jackalope
description: Justin's original cryptid: a jackalope whose antlers smolder, lighting the desert night.

title: The Fog-Mothman
description: Justin's original cryptid: a gentle giant moth that gathers fog and returns it as rain.

title: The Cinder-Yeti
description: Justin's original cryptid: a yeti of volcanic highlands, warm as bread ovens, kind to climbers.

title: The Ledger-Chupacabra
description: Justin's original cryptid: a chupacabra that drinks only spilled ink, and audits the night.

title: The Thunder-Worm
description: Justin's original cryptid: a desert worm that sings before rain, never harming anyone.

title: The Mirror-Nessie
description: Justin's original cryptid: the lake's own reflection given life, surfacing to show viewers themselves.
